description: للمرة الأولى منذ فشل خططه لإشراك مستثمرين من القطاع الخاص في منافسات الساحرة المستديرة مثل كأس العالم، سيواجه السويسري جاني إنفانتينو رئيس الاتحاد الدولي لكرة القدم (فيفا)، منتقديه، الخميس، خلال اجتماع مجلس الفيفا بمدينة زيورخ السويسرية.

title: Attacks on Ships in Strait of Hormuz Escalate Sharply
description: In a volatile moment in the region, a significant increase in attacks on vessels passing through the vital waterway is raising alarm.

title: India’s cockroach protesters defy Modi’s crackdown – The Latest
description: A fresh wave of protests by India’s youth-led Cockroach movement has been met with a brutal crackdown by Narendra Modi’s government and the closure of a historic protest site in Delhi. Two of the movement’s leaders have been imprisoned for five days for violating suppression measures. The protests, which began over frustration about education and unemployment, are now focused on voting rights. Modi’s government denies claims it is seeking to disenfranchise millions of voters.
